title: fix(app-shell): the exported register page says why a sign-up is refused, in the reader's language (objectui#11030)
body:
Fixes #11030
Clause-②: yes
Why yes (copied from the claim): the shared map is a new export of the published `@object-ui/app-shell`, which widens its public surface.

## What changed

`DefaultRegisterPage`, the register page `@object-ui/app-shell` publishes (mounted at `/register` by `examples/console-starter`), rendered `RegisterForm` with no `errorMessages`. So `RegisterForm`'s catch (`(code && errorMessages?.[code]) || authError.message`) showed the server's own English message for every refused sign-up, in every language. For `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` that message also names the internal setting "audience posture invite_only".

Triage (comment `5882764311`) ruled one map, used by both pages, and no second hand-written copy. This PR does that:

- **New export `signUpRefusalMessages(t)`** in `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/signUpRefusalMessages.ts`, re-exported from the package entry beside `DefaultRegisterPage`. It returns the refusal code to pack text map, keyed on the pack keys PR objectui#11029 added: `auth.register.errors.userExists`, `.selfRegistrationClosed` and `.emailDomainNotAllowed`. The parameter is typed with the one `TranslateFn` authority from `@object-ui/i18n`, as that type's header asks of a message builder. `useObjectTranslation()`'s `t` passes without a cast (both type-checks below are green).
- **`DefaultRegisterPage`** passes `errorMessages={signUpRefusalMessages(t)}`.
- **The console app's `RegisterPage`** passes the same call instead of its own inline object. It is the same code set, byte for byte: `USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL`, `USER_ALREADY_EXISTS`, `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`, with the same keys and the same inline `defaultValue` strings. `apps/console` already depended on `@object-ui/app-shell` (`workspace:*`), and `App.tsx` / `main.tsx` already import the barrel eagerly, so no dependency was added.
- The unknown-code fallback is unchanged. `AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR` stays unmapped on purpose (operator-facing), as the docblock says.
- Changeset `.changeset/11030-register-refusal-map.md`: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`, `'@object-ui/console': patch` (both are in the release group, and the console source changed even though what it shows did not).

**Why the name is `signUpRefusalMessages` and not a `register...` name:** in this codebase a `register` prefix names a registration function (`registerAppComponent`, `registerBuiltInLocales`). `registerRefusalMessages` would read as "register some messages". The name follows the endpoint (`/sign-up/email`) instead. The seat can rename it before landing if it prefers.

## Premises checked on `origin/main` (`63ab76112`) before any edit

1. `DefaultRegisterPage` renders `RegisterForm` with no `errorMessages`: confirmed.
2. The console page mapped exactly the four codes above: confirmed. The shared map carries that set and nothing more.
3. `apps/console/package.json` lists `"@object-ui/app-shell": "workspace:*"`: confirmed.

## Tests, all at `c209a6fc5` (the only commit on this branch)

- **New pin** `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/registerRefusalCodes-11030.test.tsx`. It renders the exported page under `zh` with the real form, a real `AuthProvider` over a real `createAuthClient`, and a real `I18nProvider`; only `fetch` is stubbed. Cases: one per mapped code (the three pack keys, with both user-exists codes), plus the unknown-code fallback, plus a check that the zh pack differs from en for all three keys. Expected text is read from the packs, not copied.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/ apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/registerRefusalCodes-10998.test.tsx` gave `Test Files 3 passed (3)` / `Tests 15 passed (15)`. The console page's objectui#10998 pin is **unchanged** and green. It is the control showing that the shared map keeps the console behaviour.
- **Ablation** (through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which checks the change on disk and restores to HEAD). Deleting `errorMessages={signUpRefusalMessages(t)}` from `DefaultRegisterPage` gave `anchor 1 -> 0`, blob `a03ba581ab2f -> 1cd1ced129f3`, then `Tests 4 failed | 2 passed (6)`. The four code cases went red, for example `Expected: "本环境未开放自助注册，请联系管理员获取邀请。"` / `Received: "Self-registration is closed on this environment (audience posture invite_only). ..."`. The pack check and the fallback stayed green, which is the expected direction. After restore, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Reverse check of the cross-package consumer:** changing the console call to `signUpRefusalMessages()` made console `tsc --noEmit` fail with `error TS2554: Expected 1 arguments, but got 0.` After restore, the blob equals HEAD. So the console type-check reads the rebuilt `packages/app-shell/dist/index.d.ts`, which carries the export (built this run; there was no `dist` before it).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test file once and `signUpRefusalMessages.ts` once, so the test is inside what that project compiles.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` exits 0. The dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/console^..." --concurrency=2`: 34/34).
- Tests that read the app-shell barrel: `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, `scripts/__tests__/vite-declared-lazy-views.test.ts`, `rootLandingHasOneResolver-10042`, `appSidebarRemoved-5817` and `expressionUser.mountSites.ratchet` gave `Test Files 5 passed (5)` / `Tests 54 passed (54)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (exit 0: "5 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` (exit 0), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (exit 0), `pnpm check:i18n-keys` (exit 0: "every literal inline defaultValue matches the value the pack serves"), and `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (exit 0: `0 new citation(s)`).
- **eslint, narrowed to the changed files**, measured as follows. (1) Population: the 5 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files. Each is in the lint population; none came back ignored. (2) `--format json` gave 5 results, 0 errors and 2 warnings. Both warnings are `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` on lines of the console page this diff does not touch (the `hasBootstrapped` latch and the org auto-select). (3) Invariance: `eslint --print-config` on the changed files shows no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot change any verdict on an untouched file.

## Declared narrowings (CI owns these)

- The full `pnpm test` farm and repo-wide `pnpm lint`.
- `check:eager-closure` / the performance budget needs a full console build. The console now imports one small module from the barrel it already loads eagerly, and drops the same amount of inline code. NOT MEASURED locally, reason: it needs a full console `vite build`, which CI runs.

## Acceptance notes

- Same family, not fixed here (outside the claim's file surface): `DefaultLoginPage` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/LoginPage.tsx` also passes no `errorMessages`. The console app's `LoginPage` maps `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` and `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` to `auth.login.errors.invalidCredentials` / `.emailNotVerified`, which exist in the packs. So on the exported login page, a refused sign-in shows the server's own message. This is read from source only and has not been reproduced at a running door, so no card is filed. It goes to the seat through the report.
- No README or guide page documents the `Default*` auth pages, so there are no docs to update.
